summary: Bank of Montreal (BMO) filed a Form 6-K announcing that it received TSX and OSFI regulatory approvals for its previously announced normal course issuer bid (NCIB). The bid authorizes repurchase of up to 25 million common shares, representing approximately 3.6% of issued and outstanding shares as of August 31, 2026, commencing September 8, 2026, and ending no later than September 7, 2027. Purchases will be made at market prices through the TSX and other venues, including an automatic purchase plan with broker BMO Nesbitt Burns Inc. The current bid of 30 million shares expires September 4, 2026, with 23,667,500 shares already repurchased at a volume-weighted average price. Watch for execution pace relative to the daily maximum of 557,961 shares, offering potential modest share-price support.
